description: Agent Water Records: submit a water right’s own record with the diversions and reported use under it: each water right the rights record holds with its id, reference, the holder, the points of diversion it states, the quantity it allows in its season and the moments its season of use opens and closes; each diversion entry with its id, reference, the right, the point of diversion, the volume diverted and the moment diverted; each reported use entry with its id, reference, the right, the moments its period starts and ends and the volume it states. The signed report gives the diversions and the rights behind them, each diversion against a right the record holds, each point of diversion against the points its right states, the diversions under each right in its season against the quantity it allows, and each diversion against its right’s season of use, and counts them, and names divergent water rights records: a diversion under a right the rights record does not hold, a diversion at a point the right does not state, diversions past the quantity the right allows in its season, and a diversion dated outside the right’s season of use; then a use report the diversions in its period do not support and a use report naming a right the record does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No diversion entries, or no rights record beside diversions, leaves those points unverified. Rights, diversions and reports match by letters and digits, points of diversion by their words with plurals folded, volumes to the hundredth in the unit the record uses, seasons and periods by the day, and a right listing no points covers any. This reads the water right itself, whoever holds it: wever_agri-irrigation-check reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its schedule and allocation, while the rights record check reads the right’s own record against the diversions under it. Verdict water_rights_record_divergent, water_rights_record_partial, water_rights_record_unverified or water_rights_record_consistent. POST /api/water-rights-record-check. Reads the water records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no system, takes no sample, contacts no regulator, customer or other utility and issues no certification, approval or water right decision, which stay with the utility, its operators and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Water Records reads records held by a water utility or water system operator: water system records with operator certifications, water quality test records from the sampling chain to the results, treatment plant records, discharge monitoring records, meter records, backflow test records and well records, and a water right’s own record, whoever holds it, each against the facility, certification, connection and survey records, the sampling plan, holding times and limits, the operating log, chemical stock and calibrations, the outfalls, discharge limits and monitoring reports, the reading history, the assembly, repair and tester records, the registration, construction and closure records, or the diversions and reported use on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the water system: what the system record lists, what the sampling chain and the treatment log support, what the discharge, meter and backflow records show, and whether the well and water right records hold up; it reads by record holder, not by the water itself: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s irrigation and water-use records against its allocation, the Agent Energy family reads utility bills and tariffs, and the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads waste manifests and disposal records, while this family reads the utility’s, the operator’s and the right’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-water-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-water-records/.
